Thanks Elena — super helpful. I pulled the redline and did a quick scan. A couple of asks from our side to speed the intake: 

1) Could you confirm if the redline includes any changes to Exhibit B (security)? If so, please send the latest security profile (PDF is fine). If not, we’ll default to our Exhibit B.

2) On indemnity: we typically ask for reciprocal language; if your counsel proposes one-sided indemnity, please note which operations drive that ask (data residency, subcontractors, etc.). Explicit examples help us triage.

3) For billing — to avoid delay, please cc accounting@starlite.ai on PO or invoicing communications and confirm net terms (Net30 by default).

Internal note: Marissa — can you pre-populate the order form with the 8 reserve GPUs and our standard pricing schedule so we can attach it to the draft? I’ll take point on legal redline reconciliation.
